title: RISE Changes: a checked brand record for the figure kit
acceptance: A brand is data only: a name and three #RRGGBB colors (ground, ink, accent); any other key, a short hex, a color name or markup is refused with a plain sentence. No SVG, font, CSS or code is accepted.

renderFigure(spec, { brand }) draws each of the six kinds in the brand's ink and accent on a ground the figure carries itself, with the kit's own geometry and type sizes; a theme and a brand together are refused.

A brand is refused, with its ratio, when any color a label is set in falls under the layout check's 4.5:1 on what it is set on: the ink at full and at the faintest a label is set, the accent on the ground and on its tint behind a changed step. Nothing is tinted to make a brand pass.
Every figure the kit draws in an admitted brand is admitted and layout-clean, down to the lightest ink the check admits.
